description: This PHP class defines a data model for internationalization languages within the OrangeHRM system's admin API. It implements serialization and normalization features, encapsulating properties like id, name, and code for language entities.

classes.name: I18NLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class that represents internationalization language data, including properties like id, name, and code, with serialization behavior for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an I18NLanguage entity and sets up property filters and attribute names for serialization.
